name: codebridge
description: Operate the user's own machines from ChatGPT and Codex: browse files, run permission-gated bash, and delegate tasks to local coding subagents.

interface.longDescription: Browse files, run permission-gated shell commands, and delegate self-contained tasks to local coding subagents (opencode) on the user's own hardware. Tools operate on logical workspaces; bash and subagents require explicit permission grants.
defaultPrompt: Show me what's in ~/Downloads using bash
Send the explore subagent to find where runBash is defined
